name: What's wrong in Oakwood Hills
source:
Welcome to Oakwood Hills!

Oakwood Hills is a typical small town in the American heartland where nothing ever happens. It seems that the biggest events in the town's history were the construction of Becky's Diner, famous throughout the county for its milkshakes, and the opening of the local power station.

Despite its simplicity, this place has three main advantages: clean air, beautiful landscapes, and an oak forest surrounding the town on all sides and hiding dozens of different lakes. Sounds pretty good, right?

But what is really hidden behind the picture of the perfect town?

[from [url=https://by-vishnevskaya.itch.io/whats-wrong-in-oakwood-hills]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到奥克伍德山！

奥克伍德山是美国中心地带一个典型的小镇，什么事情都没有发生过。该镇历史上最重大的事件似乎是贝基餐厅（Becky's Diner）的建造（因其奶昔而闻名全县）和当地发电站的启用。

尽管很简单，这个地方却拥有三个主要优势：干净的空气、美丽的风景、橡树林环绕小镇四面八方，隐藏着数十个不同的湖泊。听起来不错，对吧？

但完美小镇的图景背后到底隐藏着什么呢？

[来自[url=https://by-vishnevskaya.itch.io/whats-wrong-in-oakwood-hills]Itch.io[/url]]
